Name: Rephaiah, Son of Ishi
Summary: Son of Ishi and captain of the five hundred Simeonites who went to Mount Seir.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:42: Son of Ishi and captain of the five hundred Simeonites who went to Mount Seir.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Rephaiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
